scenario.name: r-cw-7-producer
scenario.description: Final-SHA live trace producer; process-local propagation tests are prerequisites and cannot satisfy the row.

expectedReceipts.name: process-local-propagation-tests
expectedReceipts.description: The three exact-candidate trace propagation tests pass before live fire.

expectedReceipts.name: final-sha-live-trace
expectedReceipts.description: Exact TaskFlow flowId and persisted origin/trace context join continuation.work, continuation.work.fire and the exact successful lifecycle successor run; unrelated spans in a time window do not qualify.

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Fresh trace ID for the exact final-SHA live invocation.

review.notes: Static validation and process-local tests are prerequisites only; exact deployed runtime plus fresh raw Tempo evidence is mandatory.

census.limits: Current spans lack product-emitted origin/session/turn/run and proof-run identity; raw trace evidence is behavioral-only.

redaction.rule: Persist hashes and structured IDs only; never raw prompts, tokens, or session transcripts.

controls.positive: Nonce-rendered reason joins accepted and fire spans.
controls.negative: A mismatched reason hash must not join.

verdictAuthority.pass: Behavior and raw topology are present.
verdictAuthority.partial: Telemetry or rebind prerequisites are unavailable.

execution.manual: Independent reviewer inspects raw trace JSON.
execution.relationship: Process-local tests are prerequisite; the live trace remains mandatory.

liveRunSafety.notes: The producer catalog runs exact-candidate tests first and then this live producer. Neither phase alone is a PASS.
